title: Use cacheImageName for local development environments
summary: Local development environments now use the configured cacheImageName setting to enable reuse of cached Business Central images, reducing container creation time by avoiding repeated Business Central installations.
key_points: CreateDevEnv passes cacheImageName to Run-AlPipeline instead of always using an empty imageName
BcContainerHelper can now reuse artifact-specific cached images when available
Container creation time is significantly reduced when matching images already exist
Default cacheImageName value is 'my'; users can disable by setting it to empty string
Cloud development environment behavior remains unchanged
